|lore=The Emperor disbanded the Imperial Senate 'for the duration of the emergency,' seizing absolute power. He planned to extend rule by terrorizing planets into submission.

* [https://web.archive.org/web/20070928014432/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/swallcards.pdf Complete Card List] (Decipher PDF, archive 28 September 2007) — Dark Effect: Expand The Empire, Premiere, R1
|strategy=By [mailto:bobafett@powerup.com.au Michael Sharp], Gold 29<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20011109175908/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/premiere/dark/small/expandtheempire.html</ref>

Want to drain the Light Side a little faster? It works best on [[Tatooine (Dark){{!}}Tatooine]] when your sites are as follows:

CANTINA - LARS' MOISTURE FARM - JUNDLAND WASTES

Deploy [[Expand The Empire]] at the Lars' Moisture Farm, and it will ADD the gametext of that site to both adjacent sites. Now the cantina is Force Drain +1 (making a total Force Drain of 3), and the Jundland Wastes are Force Drain +1 +1 (making a total Force Drain of 3). All this, and at all 3 sites you can add 1 to each of your weapon destiny draws!

Back all this up with a bit of ground power, and your opponent will be begging for mercy in no time!
|rulings=* Does not expand card titles, marker numbers, icons, or anything else besides game text.<ref name="scomp" />
* Does not allow docking bay transit to occur to or from a non-docking bay site.
* Two identical modifiers stack, for example 'Force drain +1 here. Force drain +1 here.' will work to add 2 to Force drains there.
* While game text is canceled or suspended at one site, it is not expanded to adjacent sites.
* Expanding the [[Tatooine: Podrace Arena]] game text to adjacent sites makes those sites non-battlegrounds while any race total > 0.
|combos=* [[Expand The Empire]] + [[Tatooine: Cantina (Dark){{!}}Tatooine: Cantina]] + [[Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm (Dark){{!}}Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm]] + [[Tatooine: Jundland Wastes]] Deploy [[Expand The Empire]] at [[Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm (Dark){{!}}Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm]], and it will add the gametext of that site to both adjacent sites. Now the [[Tatooine: Cantina (Dark){{!}}Cantina]] is Force Drain +1 (making a total Force Drain of 3), and the Jundland Wastes are Force Drain +1 +1 (making a total Force Drain of 3). All this, and at all 3 sites you can add 1 to each of your weapon destiny draws.<ref name="scomp">https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Expand%20The%20Empire</ref>
